name: Sakekoi
ability: Warm Infusion / Swift Swim / Serene Grace (hidden)
look: a serene porcelain-white koi with vermilion patches, a vermilion sake cup with a gold rim on its forehead and flowing fins
entry: Sakekoi thrives in steaming mountain springs. Locals believe a visit from one brings prosperity, harmony, and a bountiful rice harvest.
how: Wild: uncommon, swimming in its whisky-coloured ponds and lakes, in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Its ability Warm Infusion raises its Sp. Atk when a Fire-type move hits it and thaws its frozen party.
